notes: Scan 009 is a portrait sheet with the printed ACADEMIE D’AIX-MARSEILLE / INSPECTION ACADEMIQUE / DE VAUCLUSE letterhead. The author’s dark 4 in an open-topped cup stands at the head; a thin pale 8 at the bottom left is retained as external foliation, not identified as the author’s pagination. No date is written on this sheet.

The page gives three projection/composition formulas, a right-margin NB, three relations in a rectangle, a product annotated vertically by 1, an orbit sentence with an interlinear insertion, a central diagram, tuple and component formulas, and lower prose about points fixed by sigma1. The independent right-edge title and telephone note is rotated 90 degrees clockwise in the original and has been read after rotating its crop 90 degrees counterclockwise.

The entire original and exactly the two native-resolution overlapping halves were actually viewed. Fifteen distinct first-reading crops were generated and actually viewed. No OCR, outside research, other-page inspection, or TeX compilation was used. The 44 reading units count separate text/formula baselines and diagram/bracket annotations, including the two pagination numbers; every visible block is separately inventoried.

At scan 009 upper center, the two lower brackets stop before delta1. The upper-right note writes fixe without an accent. The two decorative indexed capitals in the NB and the interlinear insertion have the same unresolved S/G form; a symmetric-group interpretation was considered but is not imposed as a reading.

At scan 009 center, the lower long rightward stroke begins well to the right of the last F and is detached. The upper long stroke begins at that F. The upward-looking curl at the head of the p13 shaft was inspected; it is retained as a looped start of the downward shaft, not used to assert an additional upward map.

At scan 009 center-right, the tuple’s second opening parenthesis supplied by C is not visible; the closing parenthesis after the last y-prime is retained unmatched. The small base under the product is y|x in that visual order. The high mark on the following x-like letter is additionally uncertain between prime and plus. The mapping (x,y) mapsto y is clear. None of these notational tensions has been silently repaired.

At scan 009 lower middle, the complete E2(alpha) contains delta1(alpha) equals delta1 sigma(alpha) annotation is above the intersection. This written equality is preserved without asserting its validity or substituting an intended expression. Likewise alpha not equal delta1 and the final delta2 equals delta1(alpha) are retained as written.

At scan 009 bottom, joue le rôle de is supported by the letter sequence; H’s est le seul des is rejected. Two earlier cancellations remain doubtful. The delta2 index in the final line is resolved against delta1 by its angular head and broad foot, compared with the immediately following upright index 1 and the delta2 on the Prenons line.

The supplied MARKS file has seven rows. All seven are decided explicitly; four additional C doubts hidden inside cancellations are also recorded. There are no genuine separate drawings, no typescript overstrikes, and no physical illegibility designation added to mathematical symbols.

The two contextual notation comparisons are reading-consistency observations, not mathematical proof checks; they are retained in the report without being misclassified as CHECK_EVENTS. H’s explicit editorial notes and its transitional Hyperrecouvrements heading are excluded from the source and from the count of transcription corrections.

Before the independent audit, the main reader re-viewed existing009 p03 and p06 beside017 p03 and022 p02. The group glyphs have the same broad enclosing loop and internal return. The unresolved candidates are ordered G/S throughout this family; this changes neither certainty nor the set of alternatives and is not a correction count. Neither the symmetric-group role nor conventional typography proves the letter.

The independent audit changed graphic readings at B002/B003/B005/B006/B008/B010: the page-number cup is open, the annotation bars are flat, the enclosure has two upper gaps, and the diagram keeps its partial ends and detached course. It also records the insertion leader and sous/de uncertainty, the raised ts abbreviation, and a dark stem-plus-dot exclamation above sigma in the final equivalence (B014). These are readings of ink, not mathematical emendations.
